entities.summary: Sergei Vladimirovich Gusev is a Russian former professional ice hockey defenceman. He played in the National Hockey League (NHL) with the Dallas Stars, while enjoying a lengthy career in his native Russia in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Gusev was drafted 69th overall by the Stars in the 1995 NHL Entry Draft.
